channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: AFC moves to reform U17 and U20 Asian Cup Qualifiers to strengthen Youth competitions
item.description: Proposed changes aim to streamline calendars, balance competition levels, and boost youth development across Asia.

item.title: Blue Tigresses beat FC Schlieren 2-1 in closed-door friendly in Türkiye
item.description: Anju Tamang and Grace Dangmei score as India register first win under new head coach Amelia Valverde.

item.title: WPL 2026: Delhi Capitals hand Royal Challengers Bengaluru first loss of the season
item.description: Delhi Capitals climbed to second spot on the points table.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk aan Zee: Gukesh, Arjun, Aravindh face defeat; Pragg draws in round 7
item.description: After this tough outing, all four Indian players have now dropped to the bottom 5 positions of the overall table.

item.title: WPL 2026 Playoff race explained: Who all can Join RCB Women?
item.description: With RCB qualified, all four other teams are still in playoff contention after three-quarters of the season.

item.title: India finish runners-up at the inaugural SAFF Women's Futsal Championship
item.description: India finished the tournament with a 5-2 win over Sri Lanka on the final matchday, accumulating 12 points from 6 games.

item.title: Vijay Amritraj honoured with Padma Bhushan; Harmanpreet Kaur, Savita Punia gets Padma Shri
item.description: Tennis icon Vijay Amritraj receives India’s third-highest civilian honour as multiple sportspersons are recognised in Padma Awards 2026.

item.title: Tom Boon hat-trick powers Ranchi Royals into Hockey India League 2026 final
item.description: Ranchi Royals overcome Hyderabad Toofans 3-2 in Qualifier 2 to seal final date with Vedanta Kalinga Lancers.

item.title: PWL 2026: Haryana Thunders knock Tiigers of Mumbai Capitals out of play-off contention
item.description: Haryana Thunders dominated the Capitals, securing a convincing 6-3 victory to climb to the top of the points table.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk aan Zee: Gukesh bounces back with a win after two straight losses
item.description: Gukesh defeated Vladimir Fedoseev of Slovenia in the 8th round with the black pieces.
